Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA

06:00 PM
p.m.

An informational presentation by WILDCOAST to discuss their petition request made before the California Fish and Game Commission, to move the Swami’s Marine Conservation Area (SMCA) Marine Protect Area (MPA) boundary south, to the City of Encinitas/Solana Beach coastal border at South Cardiff State Beach
2024-10-23 Item 04C WILDCOAST Presentation

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.

CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.

8D.
Professional Consultant Services Agreement between the City of Encinitas and SWCA Environmental Consultants to provide natural resources and public outreach services for the development of a native plant ordinance. Environmental Considerations: The action before the City Council is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15060(c)(3) of the CEQA Guidelines since the action is not a "project" pursuant to Section 15378(b)(5). The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in a direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Environmental review would be determined and conducted prior to the adoption of any resulting ordinance. Contact Person: Associate Planner Cadona
Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Professional Consultant Services Agreement, in substantial form, for natural resources and public outreach services with SWCA Environmental Consultants, in an amount not-to-exceed $150,000.
2024-10-23 Item 08D Native Plant Ordinance- Professional Consultant Services Agreement
2024-10-23 Item 08D Native Plant Ordinance- Professional Consultant Services Agreement - Staff Presentation
8E.
Treasurer's Annual Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2024 and Investment Policy. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Analyst Angelini
1) Receive and file the Treasurer's Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2024; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-82, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Approving the Statement of Investment Policy for the Fiscal Year 2024-25, and Delegating the Authority to Invest City Funds to the Treasurer."
2024-10-23 Item 08E Treasurer's Annual Report June 30, 2024 and Investment Policy
8F.
Adopt Side Letter Agreement with Encinitas Battalion Fire Chiefs' Association (hereafter, EBFCA) authorizing employee contributions to IAFF Medical Expense Reimbursement Plan (hereafter, IAFF MERP) of the Washington State Council of Fire Fighters Employee Benefit Trust. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Administrative Services Manager Chapman
1) Adopt the Side Letter Agreement to Memorandum of Understanding, effective July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2027 between Encinitas Battalion Fire Chiefs' Association (EBFCA), IAFF 5376, authorizing employee contributions to IAFF MERP; and 2) Adopt Joinder Agreement between the Encinitas Battalion Fire Chiefs' Association, IAFF5376 and IAFF Medical Expense Reimbursement Plan of the Washington State Council of Fire Fighters Employee Benefit Trust.
2024-10-23 Item 08F EBFCA Side Letter Agreement for IAFF MERP
8G.
Adopt Side Letter Agreement with Encinitas Firefighter's Association (hereafter, EFFA) authorizing a change in vendor for Retirement Health Savings (RHS) plan contributions from Mission Square to the IAFF Medical Expense Reimbursement Plan (hereafter "IAFF MERP"). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Administrative Services Manager Chapman
1) Adopt the Side Letter Agreement to Memorandum of Understanding, effective January 1,2022 through December 31, 2025 between the City of Encinitas and the Encinitas Firefighter's Association (EFFA), IAFF 3787, authorizing contributions to IAFF MERP; and 2) Adopt Joinder Agreement between the Encinitas Firefighters Association (EFFA) and IAFF Medical Expense Reimbursement Plan of the Washington State Council of Fire Fighters Employee Benefit Trust (Trust).
2024-10-23 Item 08G EFFA Side Letter Agreement for IAFF MERP

PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing.

10A.
Public Hearing to consider a timely-filed appeal (Case No: APPEAL-007531-2024) of the Planning Commission's approval of a design review permit (DR) and coastal development permit (CDP) authorizing the construction of 42 single-family homes with associated landscaping, trail, and site improvements, and the placement of a temporary construction trailer at the site located at 2004-2094 Pearl Street (formerly 510, 512, 514 La Costa Avenue). Environmental Considerations: In accordance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), an Environmental Impact Report (EIR) was previously certified for the project, and the conclusions of the EIR remain unchanged. Additionally, none of the conditions described in Section 15162 of the CEQA Guidelines requiring the preparation of a subsequent EIR or subsequent mitigated negative declaration have occurred. Contact Person: Associate Planner Carr
Deny the appeal and adopt draft City Council Resolution No. 2024-119 titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Denying an Appeal and Affirming the Planning Commission's Decision Approving a Design Review Permit and Coastal Development Permit for the Construction of 42 Single Family Homes, Landscaping, Trail Improvements, Site Improvements, and Placement of a Temporary Construction Trailer Located at 2004-2094 Pearl Street (Formerly 510, 512, 514 La Costa Avenue) (CASE NOS. Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
